method: Three separate process starts; identical localhost assets/status, 20 sequential requests then in-process RSS snapshot through a fixture-only metrics route. Root transport fixtures only because workspace maps no unprivileged UID; production native root refusal tested separately. Not whole-server memory or hardware acceptance.

archive.note: 64 MiB disposable file on workspace filesystem, repeated with warm cache; timings do not predict HDD performance. Production native archive executable, original Python archive command.
